narrative.details:
I don't recognize the name of Lieutenant Paval Reethe. Your best bet would be to check with Adjutant Tesoran. He keeps track of all the records for the Theramore guard, from personnel to their equipment.

He should be able to tell you who this Reethe is with a quick check of his books.
narrative.objectives: Find out more about Reethe from Adjutant Tesoran in Theramore.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Hello, adventurer. You'd like information about a specific member of the Theramore guard? Reethe, was it?

Just give me a moment to find the right book.
